verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair governance question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log recording who changed a flag, when, or to which value. The Console API (CRUD), SSO/SCIM and exposure monitoring are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
